notes_for_editor: Thin record. Tennessee Landforms gives 'removed' with no year and no remarks, so no events are recorded. OpenStreetMap and Mapcarta add only type and location. TopoZone gives an approximate 1,175 ft (358 m) against 1,162 ft on Tennessee Landforms; the story uses Tennessee Landforms and the difference is not changed. The code '3-16' in the Tennessee Landforms entry is not explained on the page. Searches used: 2. Page reads: the waypoint, OpenStreetMap, Mapcarta and TopoZone is cited only for the map name; the anyplaceamerica page returned HTTP 403.
